landing.f3_text: Rate every episode and discuss it; spoilers stay hidden until you have seen it.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what {app} stores about you and who else is involved. {app} is open-source software, and this site is run by {operator}. Nothing here is legal advice.
privacy.contact_none: Contact details are on the site or in its source repository.

data.title: What is stored
data.body: Your account (username, an email address if you add one, a hashed password if you set one, display name, bio, profile images, language and timezone); your Telegram ID and handle if you use Telegram; the public keys of your passkeys; the shows you follow, what you have watched and rated; your comments, reports and blocks; your notification settings, notifications and push subscriptions. After you change your username, the old one is kept for 14 days so that it can redirect to you and nobody else can take it. If you use the contact form, your name, email address and message are emailed to the operator and are not stored by this site. If you chat with the support bot on Telegram, your name, Telegram ID and handle, and the language are kept with the conversation for up to 90 days after it closes, and your messages are passed to the operator through the bot; the text of the messages is not stored by this site.

signin.title: Sign-in and security data
signin.body: Sessions use cookies and hashed refresh tokens. Your two-step verification secret is stored encrypted and recovery codes are stored hashed. IP addresses are used in memory for rate limiting and are never written to the logs: security log lines record only a country code.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: Only essential cookies are used: your login session, CSRF protection, your language and short-lived security challenges. Your theme choice is kept in your browser's local storage. There are no analytics, advertising or tracking scripts.

third.title: Other services involved
third.body: Show data comes from TMDB and TVmaze, and optionally Trakt. The server makes these requests and sends nothing about you. Artwork is fetched once by the server and served from this site or from storage the operator controls, so your browser does not contact those services. If you choose Telegram, Telegram receives your sign-in and the notifications sent to you; its script is loaded only when you press the Telegram button. Push notifications pass through your browser vendor's push service. Email passes through the operator's mail provider. Your friend requests go to the other person's server. The activity you share (what you watch, your ratings, your comments and posts) and your episode comments are sent to the servers the operator has allow-listed. Activity is kept there for 14 days, and episode comments for one day unless your server confirms they still exist; comments you delete or hide are withdrawn. Comments you tag as spoilers are sent flagged as spoilers. Only your friends see your activity in their feed. You can stop sharing in your profile settings.

public.title: What others can see
public.body: Your username, display name, bio and profile images are public. Your stats, favorites and recently watched shows are public unless you make your profile private. Comments are visible to everyone and show your name. Users who block each other cannot see each other's comments.

admintools.title: What the operator's admin tools show
admintools.body: Admins can list accounts (username, display name, email address, join date), change an account's display name or email, make it read-only (ban), deactivate or delete it, set a new password or send a reset link, and open or close sign-ups. They can see recent errors, kept in memory only and with addresses reduced to a country code, and a log of the latest 200 emails the server sent: when, the recipient with most of the address hidden (for example j***@example.com), the subject and whether delivery worked or failed. The subject of a notification email can contain a show or episode title. The log holds no message text or sign-in links, and older entries are removed automatically.

use.title: How it is used
use.body: Only to run the service: showing your progress, sending the notifications you choose, hosting comment threads and preventing abuse. Your data is not sold and is not used for advertising or profiling.

retention.title: How long it is kept
retention.body: Until you delete it. Deleting your account permanently removes your account, history, comments, notifications and uploaded images. A deleted comment loses its text immediately. Notifications are removed after 90 days. Operator backups may keep copies for a short additional time. You can instead deactivate your account in Settings: your profile is hidden and you choose whether your comments are hidden, deleted or kept; signing in again reactivates it. When you delete your account the same choice applies, and comments that are kept are anonymized and moved to a deleted account so other people's replies are never lost.

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: In Settings you can download your data, edit or remove your profile, turn off any notification channel and delete your account. Under laws such as the GDPR you can also ask the operator to access, correct or erase your data.

children.title: Children
children.body: This service is not directed at children under 13, or the minimum age in your country, and does not knowingly collect their data.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If this policy changes, the new version will be posted on this page with its date. If translations differ, the English version prevails.

import.title: Import from TV Time
import.intro: Have a TV Time export? Upload it here to bring over your shows, favorites and watch history.
import.how_body: TV Time has shut down, so this only works with a data export (zip) you already downloaded. Upload it exactly as it is, without opening it.
import.what: Imported: shows you follow, favorites, shows saved for later, and every watched episode with its original date. Movies, comments and emotion votes are not imported.
import.keeps: Nothing you already track here is changed or removed. Your file is read on the server to build the import and is not kept afterwards.
import.unmatched: Shows that could not be matched
